framework_notes: This is a plain static HTML, file-based route with no demonstrated build tool, rendering framework, or TypeScript compilation.
Use standard HTML anchors and images and the existing plain CSS conventions; do not introduce React, Next.js, or Tailwind patterns.

The adapter is labeled static_markdown with frontmatter registry language, but the actual route shell is HTML and both shell-support flags are false. Adapter availability alone does not establish an operational HTML generation pipeline.
Standalone TypeScript files or Markdown frontmatter will not update the served HTML without an explicit supported consumer.
Semantic slot satisfaction does not require separately named or imported components.

patch_plan.format_note: JSON is a proposed adaptation of the configured stories/registry.ts path. If the selected adapter requires frontmatter, use its supported metadata format and implement collection into the registry instead.
work: Create a static-compatible, metadata-only registry seeded from the existing featured story and article cards.

Represent the supplied ArticleRecord contract with verified values and explicit unknown or empty values where permitted; do not invent authors, modification dates, analytics identifiers, or content availability.
